text: Usually indicates a liver/biliary disorder and becomes clinically apparent when the serum bilirubin exceeds 2 - 2.5 mg/dL. Many indicators of liver disease in the non-pregnant state are normal findings in pregnancy such as Spider naevi, Decreased plasma albumin and Increased serum lipids. Prothrombin time, transaminases and bilirubin are unaltered in normal pregnancy, Jaundice occurs in about 1 in 1,500 - 2,000 pregnancies
